desc:
!! This game is a heavy WIP and just a passion project, so expect bugs and non-final content. !!
"You are going nowhere but to hell... I hope you like it there."

Examination is a PvE horror shooter, where you're tasked to clear a highly irradiated nuclear power plant that's turned into a laboratory in the wake of the WE-30 outbreak, a nation-spanning infection that, while not indiscriminate, has swallowed select zones and regions whole, reducing them to heavily quarantined White-Zones. 
You're one of the later waves sent to the facility. What fate has befallen to the earlier waves is unknown. Don't become one of them.

Things to note:
7+ graphics are recommended.
Best played on a private server
The controls are laid out on the screen at the class lockers
The game is challenging and you are expected to falter in the beginning, don't give up!

Rules & Credits - https://devforum.roblox.com/t/examination-rules-credits/3809900

badges.desc:
"The paths of glory lead but to the grave." - Terminate Gilbert.

CHALLENGE-BASED BADGE – This badge will advance your rank, shown on your nametag.

badges.name: ["UNFORTUNATE"]
badges.desc: "Alone in this cold world." - Find the lone engineer.

badges.name: ["THE_JUGGERNAUT"]
badges.desc: "Сегодня ночью ветер пахнет металлом. Завтра будет пахнуть кровью." - Terminate SIN.

badges.desc: "I'm convinced that it's meant to be..." - Get Infected and fall into madness.

badges.name: ["HEART-OF-MENLO"]
badges.desc: "At the moment of defeat, these two arrived, buying us a second wind." - Obtained by participating in official developer's events

badges.desc:
"Don’t look for heroes out here. The heroes are already dead." - Complete the game solo (private server) as the leader class.
Reach sector 3 entrance to obtain.

CHALLENGE-BASED BADGE – This badge will advance your rank, shown on your nametag.

badges.name: ["ROLE-REVERSAL"]
badges.desc: "An eye for an eye..." - Kill a Slasher with an axe.

badges.name: ["ONE-MAN-ARMY"]
badges.desc:
"Dedication is a strong thing my friend." - Survive and Complete the game, solo (private server)
Reach sector 3 entrance to obtain.

CHALLENGE-BASED BADGE – This badge will advance your rank, shown on your nametag.

UNLOCKS:
[N] - Night_Vision
[X] - Slide

badges.name: ["UNDEREQUIPPED"]
badges.desc:
"Make do with what you have." - Complete the game without a class in a solo PRIVATE SERVER.
Reach sector 3 entrance to obtain.

CHALLENGE-BASED BADGE – This badge will advance your rank, shown on your nametag. It is meant to be ridiculously hard, unfair, and difficult. Attempt at your own digression.

badges.desc:

CHALLENGE-BASED BADGE – This badge will advance your rank, shown on your nametag.

badges.name: ["FULL_HOUSE"]
badges.desc: "The whole army is here!" - Be in a full server
